result = Box(block_length, block_width, block_height)

groove = Pos(0, 0, block_height - groove_depth/2) * Box(groove_length, groove_width, groove_depth)

pocket1 = Pos(-block_length/2 + pocket_depth/2, -block_width/2 + pocket_width/2, -block_height/2 + pocket_offset_z) * Box(pocket_depth, pocket_width, pocket_height)
